description: Wave pools and surf lakes open to the public (The Wave Bristol, URBNSURF, Alaïa Bay, Atlantic Park, DSRT Surf...): city, country, coordinates, wave technology where published (e.g. Wavegarden Cove), levels, website, notes (address, seasons), the date each was last checked and the published sources it was checked against, and a reviewed, freely licensed photo where there is one (photo: thumb, page, author, license; credit the author). Give a town slug (pools within 250 km, nearest first, with km), lat and lng (with radius_km), a country code, or nothing for all of them. Pools are inland: they work when the sea is flat, and are good for beginners and for training.

country.description: ISO 3166-1 alpha-2 country code, e.g. GB, US, AU.

lat.description: Latitude, with lng, to search around a point.

level.description: Only pools with sessions for this level.

radius_km.description: Search radius for town or lat/lng (default 250, max 5000).

town.description: Town slug: pools within 250 km of it (or radius_km).

name: surf_pools
title: Surf pools (wave pools)
